# ── bookkeeping kit: shared helpers (inlined into each node by gen-ext.js) ──
import json
import re
import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

# Knowledge layout. Folders may nest at most 2 levels, so inbox folders are top-level.
BK_SETTINGS = "Bookkeeping/settings.json"
BK_CLIENTS = "Bookkeeping/Clients"
BK_RULES = "Bookkeeping/Rules"
BK_BILLS = "Bookkeeping/Bills"
BK_INBOX = "Bookkeeping Inbox"
BK_PROCESSED = "Bookkeeping Processed"
BK_FAILED = "Bookkeeping Failed"
BK_MAIL = "Bookkeeping/Mail"
BK_REQUESTS = "Bookkeeping Requests"


def bk_write_json(path, data):
    api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))


def bk_fmt(amount, currency=""):
    if amount is None:
        return "—"
    return (currency + " " if currency else "") + "{:,.2f}".format(amount)


def bk_tz(settings):
    # The sandbox may lack the tz database; fall back to AEST (UTC+10) rather than failing the run.
    try:
        return ZoneInfo((settings or {}).get("timezone") or "Australia/Sydney")
    except Exception:
        return datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=10))


def bk_today(settings):
    return datetime.datetime.now(bk_tz(settings)).date()


def bk_now_iso(settings):
    return datetime.datetime.now(bk_tz(settings)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()


def bk_add_business_days(day, n):
    d = day
    while n > 0:
        d = d + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        if d.weekday() < 5:
            n -= 1
    return d


def bk_move(src, dst):
    """Move a knowledge file (binary-safe): copy through the run's scratch space, then delete the source."""
    local = api.files.get(file=src)
    with open(local, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()
    scratch = api.files.scratch_path(dst.split("/")[-1])
    with open(scratch, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)
    api.files.put(file=dst, scratch_file=scratch)
    api.files.delete(file=src)
    return dst


def bk_reviewer(settings, client):
    return (client or {}).get("reviewer_id") or (settings or {}).get("reviewer_id")


def bk_exceptions_owner(settings, client):
    return (settings or {}).get("exceptions_owner_id") or bk_reviewer(settings, client)


# ── bookkeeping kit: Xero ledger adapter (inlined into Xero nodes by gen-ext.js) ──
# Every write passes xero_tenant_id so it lands in the client's own Xero organisation
# (myhub-mcp-servers PR #558). Reads pass it too.
import base64
from collections import Counter

XERO = "xero-accounting"
XERO_EXPENSE_TYPES = {"EXPENSE", "DIRECTCOSTS", "OVERHEADS", "FIXED", "CURRENT", "INVENTORY", "PREPAYMENT", "NONCURRENT"}
XERO_REVENUE_TYPES = {"REVENUE", "SALES", "OTHERINCOME"}
XERO_DEAD = {"DELETED", "VOIDED"}


def xero_bill_link(bill_id, doc_type="ACCPAY"):
    area = "AccountsReceivable" if doc_type == "ACCREC" else "AccountsPayable"
    return "https://go.xero.com/" + area + "/Edit.aspx?InvoiceID=" + str(bill_id)


def xero_bill_markdown(proposal, warnings=None, blocking=None, bill_id="", file_path="", client_name=""):
    """The review item's description: what the AI read, how it coded it, and what to check."""
    p = proposal or {}
    c = p.get("contact") or {}
    cur = p.get("currency") or ""
    sales = p.get("doc_type") == "ACCREC"
    raising = p.get("origin") == "request"
    doc = "invoice" if sales else "bill"
    out = []
    if raising:
        out.append("**Invoice to raise** from " + (client_name or "the client") + " to **" + (c.get("name") or "Unknown customer")
                   + "**" + (" (new customer)" if c.get("is_new") else "") + (" · " + c["email"] if c.get("email") else ""))
    elif sales:
        out.append("**Sales invoice** from " + (client_name or "the client") + " to **" + (c.get("name") or "Unknown customer")
                   + "**" + (" (new customer)" if c.get("is_new") else ""))
    else:
        out.append("**" + (c.get("name") or "Unknown supplier") + "**" + (" (new supplier)" if c.get("is_new") else "")
                   + (" for " + client_name if client_name else ""))
    out.append("")
    out.append("- Invoice " + (p.get("invoice_number") or ("numbered by Xero" if raising else "—")) + ", dated " + (p.get("date") or "—")
               + ", due " + (p.get("due_date") or "—"))
    out.append("- Total " + bk_fmt(p.get("total"), cur) + " (GST " + bk_fmt(p.get("tax"), cur) + ", amounts "
               + ("include" if p.get("line_amount_types") == "Inclusive" else "exclude") + " GST)")
    if bill_id:
        out.append("- Draft " + doc + " in Xero: [open in Xero](" + xero_bill_link(bill_id, p.get("doc_type") or "ACCPAY") + ")")
    else:
        out.append("- Not in Xero yet: the " + doc + " is created when you approve")
    if file_path:
        out.append("- PDF: `" + file_path + "` in Knowledge")
    out.append("")
    out.append("**Lines**")
    out.append("")
    # A list, not a table: WorkQ descriptions don't render markdown tables.
    for i, ln in enumerate(p.get("lines") or []):
        desc = str(ln.get("description") or "").replace("\n", " ")[:120]
        out.append("- Line " + str(i + 1) + ": " + desc + ", " + bk_fmt(ln.get("line_amount"), cur) + ". Account **"
                   + (ln.get("account_code") or "missing") + "**, tax " + (ln.get("tax_type") or "—") + ". "
                   + str(ln.get("reason") or "")[:160] + " (" + str(ln.get("confidence") or "low") + " confidence)")
    if blocking:
        out.append("")
        out.append("**Must fix before approving**")
        out.extend("- " + b for b in blocking)
    if warnings:
        out.append("")
        out.append("**Check**")
        out.extend("- " + w for w in warnings)
    out.append("")
    if raising:
        out.append("Fill in the **Invoice to send** form on this item: approve it (and choose whether Xero emails it to the "
                   "customer), change it, reject it or ask the client.")
    else:
        out.append("Fill in the **" + ("Invoice" if sales else "Bill") + " review** form on this item to approve, change, "
                   "reject or ask the client." + (" Approving records it in Xero as awaiting payment; nothing is emailed "
                                                  "to the customer." if sales else ""))
    return "\n".join(out)


# ── Send for approval ──


problem = params.get("problem") or ""
ctx = params.get("ctx") or {}
request = params.get("request") or {}
proposal = params.get("proposal") or {}
warnings = params.get("warnings") or []
blocking = params.get("blocking") or []
bill_id = params.get("bill_id") or ""
settings = ctx.get("settings") or {}
client = ctx.get("client") or {}
slug = client.get("slug") or ctx.get("folder") or "unknown"
today = bk_today(settings)
src = str(request.get("path") or "")
outcome = ""
todo_id = ""

quoted = "\n".join("> " + ln for ln in str(request.get("text") or "")[:1500].splitlines() if ln.strip())
asked_by = ("**Requested by** " + (request.get("from") or "the client") + (", " + str(request.get("received")) if request.get("received") else "")
            + ("  \n**Subject:** " + str(request.get("subject")) if request.get("subject") else ""))

if problem:
    dest = ""
    if src:
        try:
            dest = bk_move(src, BK_FAILED + "/" + slug + "/" + src.split("/")[-1])
        except Exception:
            dest = src
    owner = bk_exceptions_owner(settings, client)
    item = api.workq.create(
        title=("Invoice request needs attention: " + (request.get("subject") or "request")
               + (" (" + client["name"] + ")" if client.get("name") else ""))[:200],
        scope="org",
        description=(problem + "\n\n" + asked_by + "\n\n" + quoted + ("\n\n- Request file: `" + dest + "` in Knowledge" if dest else "")
                     + "\n\nFix it, then run **Bookkeeping: Draft requested invoice (Xero)** by hand with the client's name "
                     "and the request text, or raise the invoice in Xero yourself, and complete this item."),
        priority="high",
        due_date=str(bk_add_business_days(today, 1)),
        assignee_ids=[owner] if owner else None,
        labels=["bookkeeping", "bill-exception", "invoice-request", slug],
    )
    todo_id = item["id"]
    outcome = "exception"
else:
    dest = ""
    if src:
        dest = bk_move(src, BK_PROCESSED + "/" + slug + "/" + src.split("/")[-1])
    c = proposal.get("contact") or {}
    reviewer = bk_reviewer(settings, client)
    title = ("Invoice to raise: " + (c.get("name") or "customer") + " " + (proposal.get("invoice_number") or "")
             + " " + bk_fmt(proposal.get("total"), proposal.get("currency") or "") + " (" + client.get("name", "") + ")")
    item = api.workq.create(
        title=re.sub(r"\s+", " ", title)[:200],
        scope="org",
        description=(asked_by + "\n\n" + quoted + "\n\n---\n\n"
                     + xero_bill_markdown(proposal, warnings, blocking, bill_id, "", client.get("name", ""))),
        priority="high" if (blocking or c.get("is_new")) else "medium",
        due_date=str(bk_add_business_days(today, 1)),
        assignee_ids=[reviewer] if reviewer else None,
        labels=["bookkeeping", "invoice-request", slug],
    )
    api.workq.attach_form(todo_id=item["id"], form_id=params["send_form"])
    levels = [str(l.get("confidence") or "low") for l in proposal.get("lines") or []]
    record = {
        "client_slug": slug,
        "tenant_id": client.get("xero_tenant_id"),
        "bill_id": bill_id,
        "proposal": proposal,
        "warnings": warnings,
        "blocking": blocking,
        "confidence": "low" if (blocking or "low" in levels) else ("medium" if "medium" in levels else "high"),
        "file": "",
        "request": {k: request.get(k) for k in ("from", "subject", "received", "mailbox", "source")},
        "request_file": dest,
        "created_at": bk_now_iso(settings),
        "history": [],
        "status": "in_review",
        "review_todo_id": item["id"],
    }
    bk_write_json(BK_BILLS + "/" + item["id"] + ".json", record)
    todo_id = item["id"]
    outcome = "review"
